metadata.classificationRule: Every strand-grade JSON record is assigned to exactly one section. The source topic title determines the default section; all subtopics were reviewed, and clearly mismatched source labels receive a record-level section and display-title correction.
metadata.displayDeduplicationRule: Within the same section and grade, identical display titles are merged and their unique subtopics remain available for future detail pages.
